Select exact IC50 activities in nM for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) that have a canonical SMILES string and a PubMed ID or DOI. Use the provenance-rich join path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary, with an INNER JOIN to compound_structures to enforce the SMILES requirement. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Output columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
